description.content:
The Wondercraft Public API creates audio content - podcasts, audio ads, meditations, and audiobooks - from an AI-generated or user-supplied script. Generation is asynchronous: a create request returns a job_id, which is polled for completion and an MP3 download URL. API access requires a paid plan.

Contact Support:
 URL: https://support.wondercraft.ai/

item.name: Create any audio content with an AI-generated script

request.description: Generates audio content from a natural-language prompt with an AI-written script. Returns a job_id.

item.name: Create any audio content with a user-provided script

request.description: Generates audio from a user-provided script of ordered text/voice_id segments. Returns a job_id.

item.name: Generate AI-scripted podcast with 2 hosts using Convo Mode

request.description: Generates a two-host conversational podcast from a prompt. Requires exactly two voice IDs. Returns a job_id.

item.name: Generate podcast with 2 hosts using Convo Mode and a user-provided script

request.description: Generates a two-host conversational podcast from a user-provided script. Returns a job_id.

item.name: Get audio content result and status

variable.description: The job_id returned by a generate request.

request.description: Retrieves job status. When finished, returns the generated script and an MP3 download URL.

item.name: Get podcasts for the authenticated user

request.description: Returns the podcasts associated with the authenticated API key.
Verifies the supplied API key and returns the associated account email.
